approved_text: Tychon Software employs a proven 5-phase Cloud Adoption Framework tailored for regulated enterprise environments: (1) Discovery & Automated Dependency Mapping, (2) Target Landing Zone & Security Hardening, (3) Wave-based Migration & Pilot Validation, (4) Zero-Downtime Data Cutover via Continuous Replication, and (5) Hypercare, Optimization & Operational Handover. Each migration wave undergoes rigorous pre-flight smoke testing and rollback drills before DNS switchover.

Tychon Software operates under a fully certified ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System (Certificate 12 104 59281 TMS). All software development adheres to DevSecOps principles with automated static analysis (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and mandatory vulnerability gating prior to artifact promotion. Data in transit is protected using TLS 1.3 and data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 with customer-managed keys (CMK).

We implement a bi-weekly sprint cadence utilizing Scrum and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) practices. Delivery governance is anchored by transparent sprint demos, automated burndown metrics, and a dedicated Joint Steering Committee meeting monthly. All deliverables are subject to clear Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria, verified by automated test suites achieving over 85% code coverage.

topic: Service Level Agreements, High Availability & Disaster Recovery
approved_text: Tychon Software guarantees a production availability SLA of 99.95% backed by multi-availability-zone infrastructure and automated health-check failover. For mission-critical tier-1 workloads, our architecture guarantees Recovery Point Objective (RPO) <= 15 minutes and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) <= 60 minutes. Incident response protocols mandate Priority 1 response within 15 minutes and 24x7 escalation support.
